title: Validator build: KSI-INR-RIR
design: I-18, KSI-INR-RIR. Reviewed and marked Verified by the fedramp20x repository owner; used here as the validated design

inputs.description: Validator design, INR theme: KSI-INR-RIR, status Verified in fedramp20x

items.reads: POL-INR (owner and requirements table), the incident response plan, ir_plan.review_cadence_days in the GRC records
conditions_checked: the cadence is a positive number of 365 days or less
the plan exists and has no TODO lines

break_tests.change: plan: appended 'TODO: write the containment steps'
break_tests.observed_message: The incident response plan is not finished: TODO on line(s) 148

break_tests.change: policy: replaced '| Owner | CISO |' with '| Owner | |'

items.gap: Proves the plan is written and the cycle is documented. Does not prove the plan's procedures are effective.

items.reads: ir_plan.reviews, incidents and incident_pattern_reviews in the GRC records, measured against the run date
conditions_checked: the newest review is not after the run date
the newest review is no older than the cadence
the newest review was recorded by the POL-INR owner
a review follows each after action report or past incident review that required a plan change

break_tests.observed_message: The plan review dated 2026-11-21 was recorded by 'GRC Lead', POL-INR names 'CISO'
The newest plan review is 366 days old, the cadence is 365 days

items.gap: Proves the owner reviewed the plan on time and after each required change. Does not prove the review judged the procedures effective, or that a report correctly decided whether a change was needed. The current incident and past incident review records hold no dated entries, so the plan-change condition is tested only by the unit tests.
